name: Minakami Narumi
source:
Slacker maid. But her cooking is top class which is why she’s still around. Scolded by [url=/c1581]Akane[/url] constantly for slacking even though she’s senior. Very easygoing and lazy, so it’s hard to actually get her to talk or do anything.
